rules.label: tokenUsage
rules.reason: Legacy usage object. Use ModelTrace.usage.

rules.label: conclusionNotice
rules.reason: Legacy fallback notice. Use AgentConclusion.notice for user-facing notices and ModelTrace for fallback / model error state.

rules.label: agentConclusion.source
rules.reason: AgentConclusion owns text and notice only. Use ModelTrace.conclusionSource.

rules.label: agentConclusion.conclusionSource
rules.reason: Conclusion source belongs to ModelTrace.conclusionSource.

rules.label: agentConclusion.fallbackReason
rules.reason: Fallback reason belongs to ModelTrace.fallbackReason.

rules.label: agentConclusion.modelErrorType
rules.reason: Model error type belongs to ModelTrace.modelErrorType.

rules.label: agentConclusion.content
rules.reason: Use AgentConclusion.markdownText and AgentConclusion.plainText.

rules.label: agentConclusion.summary
rules.reason: Use AgentConclusion.sections or AgentConclusion.notice.

rules.label: metadata.clientRunId
rules.reason: clientRunId is only pending / idempotency state, not persisted metadata relationship.

rules.label: modelTrace.tokenUsage
rules.reason: Legacy model trace field. Use modelTrace.usage.

rules.label: usage ?? tokenUsage
rules.reason: Old/new fallback chain. Normalize usage once in mapper.

rules.label: tokenUsage || usage
rules.reason: Old/new fallback chain. Normalize usage once in mapper.

rules.label: usage || tokenUsage
rules.reason: Old/new fallback chain. Normalize usage once in mapper.

rules.label: rawRun.conclusionSource ?? 'mock'
rules.reason: Mock source must be explicit and not a raw fallback.

rules.label: metadata.provider
rules.reason: Provider must come from canonical modelTrace.

rules.label: metadata.selectedModelId
rules.reason: Selected model id must come from canonical modelTrace.

rules.label: metadata.model
rules.reason: Model must come from canonical modelTrace.

rules.label: metadata.conclusionSource
rules.reason: Conclusion source must come from canonical modelTrace.conclusionSource.

rules.label: metadata.usage
rules.reason: Usage must come from canonical modelTrace.usage.

rules.label: metadata.costEstimate
rules.reason: Cost estimate must come from canonical modelTrace.costEstimate.

rules.label: metadata.fallbackReason
rules.reason: Fallback reason must come from canonical modelTrace.fallbackReason.

rules.label: metadata.modelErrorType
rules.reason: Model error type must come from canonical modelTrace.modelErrorType.

rules.label: metadata.sources
rules.reason: Source lineage must be exposed through canonical top-level sources, not report metadata.

rules.label: metadata.sourceCount
rules.reason: Source count must be exposed through canonical top-level sourceCount, not report metadata.

rules.label: metadata.source_count
rules.reason: Legacy snake_case source count must stay inside DB / mapper boundaries.

rules.label: metadata.sourceLineage
rules.reason: Source lineage must be exposed through canonical top-level sourceLineage, not report metadata.

rules.label: metadata.source_lineage
rules.reason: Legacy snake_case source lineage must stay inside DB / mapper boundaries.

rules.label: metadata.sourceNoSourceReason
rules.reason: No-source reason must be exposed through canonical top-level sourceNoSourceReason, not report metadata.

rules.label: metadata.source_no_source_reason
rules.reason: Legacy snake_case no-source reason must stay inside DB / mapper boundaries.

rules.label: metadata.tokenUsage
rules.reason: Usage must come from canonical modelTrace.usage.

rules.label: metadata.conclusionNotice
rules.reason: Conclusion notice belongs to AgentConclusion.notice.

rules.label: runtime_run_id
rules.reason: Legacy runtime run id is removed. Use canonical runId / agent_runs.id.

rules.label: conclusion_source
rules.reason: Legacy DB conclusion source field is removed. Use modelTrace.conclusionSource.

rules.label: source_count
rules.reason: Legacy snake_case source count must not appear outside DB / mapper boundaries.

rules.label: source_lineage
rules.reason: Legacy snake_case source lineage must not appear outside DB / mapper boundaries.

rules.label: source_no_source_reason
rules.reason: Legacy snake_case no-source reason must not appear outside DB / mapper boundaries.

rules.label: sourceCount ?? source_count
rules.reason: Release checks must validate canonical sourceCount only.

rules.label: source_count ?? sourceCount
rules.reason: Release checks must validate canonical sourceCount only.

rules.label: sourceLineage || source_lineage
rules.reason: Release checks must validate canonical sourceLineage only.

rules.label: source_lineage || sourceLineage
rules.reason: Release checks must validate canonical sourceLineage only.

rules.label: runId || run_id
rules.reason: API checks must validate canonical runId only.

rules.label: run_id || runId
rules.reason: API checks must validate canonical runId only.

rules.label: sourceNoSourceReason || source_no_source_reason
rules.reason: Release checks must validate canonical sourceNoSourceReason only.

rules.label: source_no_source_reason || sourceNoSourceReason
rules.reason: Release checks must validate canonical sourceNoSourceReason only.

rules.label: conclusionNotice || notice
rules.reason: AgentConclusion.notice is the canonical user-facing notice.

rules.label: notice || conclusionNotice
rules.reason: AgentConclusion.notice is the canonical user-facing notice.

rules.label: sources || metadata.sources
rules.reason: Source lineage must come from canonical top-level sources.

rules.label: metadata.sources || sources
rules.reason: Source lineage must come from canonical top-level sources.
